dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute; sharp termination with a narrow pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-dominant; the vertical pixel height is approximately 1.8 times the horizontal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex parabolic arc; smooth structural curvature across the frontal cranial region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Tapered protrusion; visible length is roughly 35% of the melon's horizontal width in this perspective.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan color profile with significant digital pixelation and lack of organic texture.
